title: Sparkly diamond
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='diaTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#a8e8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#5ec8f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='diaBot' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7fd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3ab0e0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='diaMid' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c0f0ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#80dcff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Diamond body -->
  <!-- Top crown -->
  <polygon points='50,18 72,38 50,48 28,38' fill='url(#diaTop)' stroke='#d4f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Middle band -->
  <polygon points='28,38 72,38 50,48' fill='url(#diaMid)' stroke='#d4f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Left pavilion -->
  <polygon points='28,38 50,48 50,82' fill='url(#diaBot)' stroke='#d4f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Right pavilion -->
  <polygon points='72,38 50,48 50,82' fill='#4bc4ec' stroke='#d4f4ff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Center highlight facet -->
  <polygon points='50,18 62,30 50,40 38,30' fill='#e8fbff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Bottom tip highlight -->
  <polygon points='44,55 50,48 56,55 50,72' fill='#b8eeff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <!-- Top-left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(18,14)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-7' x2='0' y2='7' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-7' y1='0' x2='7' y2='0' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='-4' x2='4' y2='4' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='4' y1='-4' x2='-4' y2='4' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2.5' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(82,20)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkle near top -->
  <g transform='translate(74,10)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#ffe870' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#ffe870' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Left sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(12,50)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(90,58)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='-3' x2='3' y2='3' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='3' y1='-3' x2='-3' y2='3' stroke='#ffe060' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(30,82)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-5' x2='0' y2='5' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-5' y1='0' x2='5' y2='0' stroke='#fff7a8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.8' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom-right sparkle -->
  <g transform='translate(76,80)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#ffe870' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#ffe870' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-2' y1='-2' x2='2' y2='2' stroke='#ffd840' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='2' y1='-2' x2='-2' y2='2' stroke='#ffd840' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.5' fill='#fffde0'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny floating sparkles -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='8' r='1.5' fill='#fffde0'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='6' r='1.2' fill='#ffe870'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='32' r='1.2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  <circle cx='94' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffe870'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='72' r='1.2' fill='#fffde0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='72' r='1.2' fill='#ffe870'/>
</svg>
